1 HC-KAR  BANGALORE-560 070.
 ...RESPONDENTS (BY SRI.VINAY MAHADEVAIAH., LEARNED HCGP FOR RESPONDENT NO.1)

THIS WRIT PETITION FILED PRAYING TO-QUASH THE ENTIRE PROCEEDINGS IN SC NO.1190/2021, PENDING ON THE FILES OF THE HONBLE CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE (CCH-54), AT BENGALURU, AGAINST THE PETITIONER FOR OFFENCES PUNISHABLE UNDER SECTIONS 376, 417 AND 506 OF INDIAN PENAL CODE, 1860 WHICH IS AT ANNEXURE-D ALONG WITH FIR NO 139/2019, DATED 16/09/2020, FOR OFFENCES UNDER SECTIONS 506, 376, 417 OF INDIAN PENAL CODE, 1860 AND COMPLAINT DATED 16/09/2020 WHICH IS ANNEXED AS ANNEXURE-A AND B, CHARGE SHEET DATED 14/12/2020 AT ANNEXURE-C.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MS JUSTICE J.M.KHAZI

Since Sri.Dilraj Rohit Sequeira, learned counsel has filed NOC Vakalath for the petitioner, the Registry is directed to remove the name of Dr.M.Sunil Sastry, as NC: 2025:KHC:19193 HC-KAR learned counsel representing the petitioner in the cause list.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo seeking permission to withdraw the petition.
In the light of the same, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is going abroad and direction may be given to the Trial Court to dispose of the matter at the earliest, preferably within a period of six months.

In the light of the submission, the Trial Court is directed to dispose of the case as early as possible,
preferably within a period of six months.

Sd/-
